mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ainer_identity_login_identity (id, account_id, type, provider_authority, normalized_identifier, status, verified_at, linked_at, last_used_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{accountId}, #{type}, #{providerAuthority}, #{normalizedIdentifier}, #{status}, #{verifiedAt}, #{linkedAt}, #{lastUsedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, account_id, type, provider_authority, normalized_identifier, status, verified_at, linked_at, last_used_at FROM ainer_identity_login_identity WHERE account_id = #{accountId} ORDER BY linked_at
